overview: Based on the published agenda, this special meeting of the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to address personnel matters, teacher salary adjustments for the 2026-27 school year, and employee handbook updates. The board was expected to consider approval of a negotiated salary settlement and modifications to employee policies ahead of the upcoming school year.

agenda.item: II.A. Appointments (Additional Staff, Replacement Staff, Contract Increases)

discussions.body: Elizabeth Channel and Tabatha Gundrum were scheduled to present on budget updates and potential changes to teaching staff salaries for the 2026-27 school year, with an estimated presentation time of 10 minutes. The presentation was expected to address a negotiations settlement and review the pending 2026-27 teacher salary schedule.

Tabatha Gundrum was scheduled to share additional employee handbook updates for the 2026-27 school year, with an estimated presentation time of 2 minutes. The presentation was expected to include a marked-up version of the handbook illustrating suggested edits for board review and approval.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to approve the consent agenda including appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements
Action was requested for approval of the 2026-27 teacher salary schedule based on the negotiations settlement
Action was requested for approval of the 2026-27 employee handbook updates
title: Special Meeting - 2026-08-03
